WhyChooseUs.description: EXPRADO TRADING & CONTRACTING CO. is a 100% Saudi-owned enterprise executing multidisciplinary infrastructure, industrial, and commercial projects across the Kingdom. Our integrated service model ensures every project benefits from civil, electrical, and mechanical expertise — all under one responsible contractor.
